scripts.text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS var_bccs_src_count FROM phs_overdose_src.bccs;

SELECT max_export_service_date AS var_last_date_pcr, new_rows_flag AS var_new_rows_pcr
FROM 
[phs_overdose].[cfg_export_file]
WHERE source_system = 'PCR'

SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM phs_overdose.fact_bccs_embargo)
			THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phs_overdose.fact_bccs)
			ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phs_overdose.fact_bccs_embargo)
			END
			AS var_bccs_edw_count;

DECLARE @rec as varchar(100)
DECLARE @copy_rec as varchar(255)
DECLARE @msg_body as varchar(500)
DECLARE @msg_subject as varchar(200)
DECLARE @impt as varchar(10)
DECLARE @error_msg as varchar(500)

SET @rec=@var_recipients
SET @copy_rec=@var_pcr_moh_copy_recipients
SET @msg_subject=@var_fncf_subj
SET @error_msg=@var_fncf_msg



BEGIN
SET @msg_body= @error_msg + CHAR(13)+ CHAR(13)+ '***End of Message***'
SET @impt='High'
END
exec msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail
@recipients = @rec,
@copy_recipients=@copy_rec,
@body =@msg_body,
@body_format = 'TEXT' , 
@subject =@msg_subject,
@importance=@impt

UPDATE [phs_overdose].[cfg_export_file]
SET new_rows_flag = 'N',
last_job_run_dt_tm = GETDATE()
WHERE source_system = 'PCR';
